prompt:
You are at the camera position in this single street-view photograph. Give a natural first-person description that would help another person identify this place.

Describe only what is visibly supported by THIS photograph. Choose two to four distinctive, relatively persistent cues: building facades, road or intersection geometry, signs, storefronts, pavement markings, vegetation, and their spatial relationships. Mention a place name, logo, sign text, color, or left/right direction only if clear in the image. Do not invent unseen surroundings or infer a location from outside knowledge. Ignore moving vehicles and people. Write one or two fluent English sentences, 25–55 words, without mentioning the photograph or your task. Output only the description.
source: one cam1 query image per request; no reference image, caption, GPS, or result
